info.title: PoA Domains Worker API
info.description: Worker = production. Node is local development only. Registry livePoA:false; native naming is not enabled. Registry amounts are internal units, not native POA or wallet money. POA new-name checkout starts at 100 POA for common names and 1000 POA for premium names; read the live quote poaPrice and escrow capabilities before paying. Hidden stored names remain reserved; PUBLIC_RECORD_WITHHELD is not permission to re-register. Escrow is a separately gated service. No keys/server-side signing; exact signed-packet retries only. The two disabled lease replay actions are not part of this supported signing contract.

post.description: Explicit browser search telemetry only, never a registry or escrow action. Requires an approved same-site Origin. Private daily-partitioned R2 JSONL shards store a bounded canonical query, server timestamp, host, browser-reported coarse result and source only. Contact/wallet/key-like input is rejected. No IP, account, cookie, user agent or personal-identifier hashes are stored. No public log-reading endpoint.
